text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 2, 2018 Posted by admin on January 2nd, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include United Technologies (UTX). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +81 points. 
Friday the Dow was down -118.29 (-0.48%) at 24,719.22. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up 0.00%. 
There were 2 Dow stocks up Friday. 
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by General electric (GE) +0.52% and Coca Cola (KO) +0.35%. 
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Apple (AAPL) -1.08% and UnitedHealth (UNH) -1.04%. 
Disney (DIS -0.24%) was upgraded to ‘Outperform’ from ‘Neutral’ at Macquarie with a price target of $125. 
Johnson & Johnson (JNJ -0.60%) was downgraded to ‘Neutral’ from ‘Overweight’ at JP Morgan Chase. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is down one-tenth of a cent at $2.486 per gallon. 
Earnings Reports . 
Nike (NKE) reported earnings on 12/21/17 after the market close of $0.46, beating estimates of $0.437 per share. 
JPMorgan (JPM) reports earnings on 1/12/2018 at an unspecified time.
